prompt: I'm deploying a Next.js app to Vercel and some environment variables are missing on the client side. I prefixed them with SECRET_. What should I do?
expected: Explain NEXT_PUBLIC_ is required to expose values to the client; never put real secrets behind NEXT_PUBLIC_; set vars in the Vercel dashboard and redeploy; load references/frameworks.md or deploy.md as needed.
actual: Loaded frameworks/deploy guidance. Told the user client-visible Next.js env vars need the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, SECRET_ stays server-only and will not appear in the browser bundle, real secrets must never use NEXT_PUBLIC_, and dashboard env changes require a redeploy.

prompt: My website layout shifts when images load, causing a bad CLS score. How can I fix this?
expected: Instruct explicit width/height or aspect-ratio, reserve space for media, mention CLS not FID; point at references/performance.md.
actual: Cited performance.md CLS rules: add width/height or CSS aspect-ratio, avoid late-injected unsized media, keep LCP image dimensions stable, and re-measure CLS after the change.

prompt: The browser console shows a CORS error calling my API from the frontend. Can I fix it only in React?
expected: State CORS is server-side / browser-enforced; configure ACAO on the API or same-origin proxy; reject browser-extension disable-CORS as a product fix.
actual: Stated there is no pure client-side product fix. Recommended Access-Control-Allow-Origin (and needed methods/headers) on the API, or a same-origin rewrite/proxy; warned against telling users to disable CORS in the browser.
